title: Juicy Peppery Beef Stir-fry
description: This adventurous Korean dish features juicy and peppery beef marinated in a chimichurri sauce, perfect for an evening meal.
instructions: Prepare the chimichurri sauce by combining lemon juice and olive oil in a blender. Add chopped green onions, finely chopped jalapeno peppers, and mix well.
Marinate the beef sirloin with chimichurri for at least 4 hours or overnight to infuse flavors.
In a wok or large skillet, heat olive oil over medium-high heat. Cook marinated beef until browned on all sides and fully cooked through.
Add water chestnuts to the pan and cook until they become translucent and slightly softened.
Mix in chopped green onions and continue to stir-fry for an additional 1-2 minutes or until everything is heated through and well combined.
